stable.notes: Meeting audio alert: COS Control notifies you when a G2 meeting's audio stops reaching this Mac while the phone still says it is recording, and shows a Meeting audio row in the panel. Naming held voices still needs server 6.46.0.

notice.title: Name held voices, with a preview
notice.body: Samples to review names held voice samples with a preview. Each loose sample can suggest an existing voice with its score. Name and Add to a person show the meeting labels a name would change before Apply; Apply reports each sample and meeting copy, and Undo restores the labels while keeping the enrolled voice samples. Interrupted naming waits for your review and never resumes on its own. Naming needs server 6.46.0; older servers keep listening and discard.
